invariants.rationale: Method parameter is expected to identify the restore instant and should not be null.
Restore operation requires a savepoint timestamp to restore to, and this should not be null.
A restore instant timestamp should not be empty, as it represents a required operation point.
A savepoint timestamp should not be an empty string, since it is required to identify a specific savepoint.
The context is required for execution and must not be null for most table operations.
